source: Wikipedia Nasopharyngeal airway (en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nasopharyngeal_airway): size measured nostril to earlobe/angle of jaw; lubricate; bevel toward septum until flared end rests at nostril; contraindicated with facial/nasal trauma or suspected skull fracture.
